project.title: 12 Principles of Multimedia Design
project.description: I've always enjoyed making lessons easier to follow, so I had fun putting this presentation together. Instead of just listing the principles, I wanted to show why they matter and how they can make learning materials clearer and more engaging.

project.title: Google Privacy Policy Infographic
project.description: Privacy policies can feel like a lot to take in, especially when they're packed with lengthy explanations. With this infographic, I tried to make the important points easier to spot and understand, because information about our personal data shouldn't feel so hard to read.

project.title: Four Waves of Feminism
project.description: What interested me most while making this video was seeing how women's concerns and demands changed from one wave to the next. Rather than treating them as separate moments in history, I wanted to connect the stories and help viewers see how earlier struggles shaped the conversations we still have today.

project.title: Whisker & Wonder
project.description: Our group created a website for an animal-inspired T-shirt brand that promotes kindness toward stray and rescued animals. As the main coder, I turned our collaborative design into a responsive website and helped make the navigation and pages work together.
